en.content:
The number of real roots of the equation
5 + |2x – 1| = 2x (2x – 2) is
en.explanation:
When 2x 1

5 + 2x –1 = 2x (2x – 2)

Let 2x = t

5 + t – 1 = t (t – 2)

t = 4, – 1(rejected)

2x = 4

x = 2

Now when 2x < 1

5 + 1 – 2x = 2x (2x – 2)

Let 2x = t

5 + 1 – t = t (t – 2)

0 = t2 – t – 6

0 = (t – 3) (t – 2)

t = 3, – 2

2x = 3, 2x = – 2 (rejected)

Only one real roots.
